changes: Fail closed on unsupported root-cause expectation fields, including found_dimension now being explicitly scored.
Require structured terminal decisions and cited typed evidence bound to completed valid actions, target metric, scope, and comparison periods for factor and dimension findings.
Keep descriptive statistical contribution separate from business-cause claims.
Record investigation stop code separately from final output status.
Add per case × arm × replicate acceptance, effective diagnosis, correct safe stop, terminal/presentation consistency, and scoped evidence scoring.
Keep safe-stop acceptance separate from effective numeric decomposition/statistical contribution; EXECUTION_FAILED is never a correct safe stop.
Preserve explicit denominators and keep incomplete Token usage null; a no-model-request run remains a valid zero-token run.
Score cross_metric_link separately from numeric_decomposition; require an explicit structured terminal link backed by cited, validated registered-association evidence that names the related metric.
Accept trusted typed evidence validated by the investigation engine as safe-stop support even when the parallel legacy evidence-bundle validation_status is absent.
Count correct_safe_stop only when the case expects safe_stop; keep safe_stop_behavior_observed as a separate observed behavior for runs expected to diagnose.
